name: Service Order-dispatch_instructions
label: Dispatch Instructions
description: Auto-copied from the linked Service Request's Description the first time this Order is saved (if blank), and editable/appendable here afterward. Flows forward to Service Appointment automatically.

name: Service Appointment-dispatch_instructions
label: Dispatch Instructions
description: Auto-copied from the linked Service Order's Dispatch Instructions the first time this Appointment is saved (if blank). Read-only for the technician in the Tech PWA — this is not the Description field (which is shared boilerplate pulled from Service Type).

name: Service Appointment-customer_notes
label: Customer Notes
description: Visible on the customer-facing service report. Entered by the technician in the Tech PWA.

name: Service Appointment-internal_notes
label: Internal Notes
description: Office/dispatch only. Never included on customer-facing documents.
